steps.command: whoami; cat /etc/os-release | head -5; which nginx || true; ls /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null || true
apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nginx

mkdir -p /var/www/html && printf 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver\n' > /var/www/html/index.html && printf 'Page not found - Please check your URL\n' > /var/www/html/404.html && rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default

nginx -t && (nginx -s reload 2>/dev/null || nginx) && sleep 1; echo '--- index ---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl -s http://localhost:8080/; echo '--- 404 ---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/nope; curl -s http://localhost:8080/nope; echo '--- logs ---'; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo '--- processes ---'; pgrep -a nginx
namei -l /var/www/html/index.html; ls -la /var/www /var/www/html; ps aux | grep -i nginx | grep -v grep; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log 2>/dev/null; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/error.log
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '8080|:80 '; ls -la /run/nginx.pid 2>/dev/null; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *nginx*) echo "$p: $c";; esac; done
env | grep -i proxy; curl -sv http://localhost:8080/ -o /tmp/resp.txt 2>&1 | tail -20; cat /tmp/resp.txt; echo; wc -l /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

echo '--- index ---'; curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl -s --noproxy '*' http://localhost:8080/; echo '--- 404 ---'; curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/nope; curl -s --noproxy '*' http://localhost:8080/nope; echo '--- logs ---'; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo '--- error log ---'; ls -l /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log
